title: Seasons wheel
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Similar-sounding letters; the four seasons; my mother
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: seasons wheel)
intro: Lesson 15: The four seasons. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Colour each season and write its weather word inside: مُعْتَدِل, حَارّ, تَسْقُطُ الأَوْرَاقُ, بَارِد.

panels.title: Sentences
points: In summer the weather is hot

questions.q: Say: in winter the weather is cold.
Seasons wheel on the pupil PDF: label the four parts with the season names and write one weather sentence for each; then answer: أُحِبُّ ... لِأَنَّ ...
questions.a: Four labels, four sentences, and an opinion with a reason

questions.q: Extend: which season is it now in the UK?
Stretch: say why you like a season: أُحِبُّ الشِّتَاءَ لِأَنَّ ...
questions.a: For example: أُحِبُّ الشِّتَاءَ لِأَنَّ الثَّلْجَ جَمِيلٌ

questions.q: Think again: which season shows Allah's power?
